presets.title: Background image
presets.desc: The shell's background image and paper colour behind the app and every article.

presets.title: Sepia
presets.desc: Warm sepia paper everywhere: #f4ecd8 in the app, lighter paper in articles.

presets.title: True black
presets.desc: OLED black chrome; in dark mode articles flip to white on black.

presets.title: Warm dark
presets.desc: Dark mode in warm browns instead of grey.

presets.title: High contrast
presets.desc: Light mode without the blinding white: near-black text on warm off-white.

presets.title: Wider column
presets.desc: The wide reading column on every launch, not just for one session.

presets.title: Compact
presets.desc: Phone fit: the app's side gutters go, and articles give back their desktop margins and stop dragging sideways.

presets.title: Quieter results
presets.desc: Less furniture around the results: no card borders, result counts or provenance block.

presets.title: Roomier lines
presets.desc: Articles set like prose: taller lines and air between paragraphs.

presets.title: Serif font
presets.desc: A serif face (Georgia) for the app and for dictionary text.

presets.title: Condensed
presets.desc: A narrow face - more of a long entry per line, at the same size.

presets.title: Light
presets.desc: The light cut of the system font: thinner strokes, a quieter page.

presets.title: Bolder text
presets.desc: A hair of extra weight for screens where the type looks washed out.

presets.title: Justified text
presets.desc: Articles justified, hyphenated where the dictionary declares a language.

presets.title: Wide tables
presets.desc: Conjugation tables scroll inside themselves instead of widening the article.

presets.title: Dictionary roles
presets.desc: Colour and style for the parts wudict labels in DSL and XDXF articles: parts of speech, examples, transcriptions.

presets.title: Quiet examples
presets.desc: Examples in the text colour instead of blue, one size down.

presets.title: Tighter indents
presets.desc: DSL nesting indents at half depth.
